sources.title: Dromornis planei (Bullockornis planei)
sources.evidence: Official species account read, updated2026-06-30: estimated2.5m/300kg, large deep curved bill, longneck and enormous legs. Header image is D.stirtoni explicitly excluded. Wings largely unknown.

sources.title: Endocranial Anatomy of the Giant Extinct Australian Mihirung Birds (Aves,Dromornithidae)
sources.author: Handley and Worthy2021
sources.evidence: Original paper relevant methods/captions read and Fig1 inspected; C/D NTM P9464-106 D.planei braincase,40mm bar. Other panels different species. Cranial deformation discussed.
sources.rights: CC BY journal paper; retained private source only.

sources.title: Skull morphology of the enigmatic Genyornis newtoni
sources.author: McInerney et al2024
sources.evidence: Original Fig8 and adjacent text inspected. D.planei NTM P932-2 rostrum AB50mm/C20mm bars; distortion/cavitation. NTM P.9973-2 uncompressed rostrum suggests breadth underestimated in older reconstructions. Dromornis dorsal bill hemispherically curved.
sources.rights: Author/publisher rights retained; original necessary page kept privately, no public reference image embedding.

sources.title: Dromornis planei skull photograph
sources.evidence: Actual Flinders photograph viewed, cranium and separate partial bill held apart. Not a scale reference and not evidence of complete individual.
